subject: economics

moments.title: Nixon ends dollar-gold convertibility
moments.body: Nixon's Sunday-evening 15 August announcement ends dollar-gold convertibility, effectively ending the Bretton Woods system.
moments.takeaway: Fixed exchange rates were abandoned by their hegemonic anchor.

moments.title: Generalised floating
moments.body: Major currencies move to floating exchange rates. Oil shocks the same year amplify the transition.
moments.takeaway: Floating rates became the new normal.

moments.title: Plaza Accord
moments.body: Coordinated G5 intervention depreciates the dollar. The accord demonstrates managed flexibility within a floating regime.

now.title: Currency regimes today
now.body: Mix of floating, pegged and currency-board regimes. Reserve currency status remains concentrated in dollar.
now.open_questions: Will Chinese yuan or digital currencies displace dollar dominance?

reflection: The collapse of Bretton Woods reshaped international macroeconomics and monetary theory.
